from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from one company's financial statement."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company this financial statement belongs to")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="The financial line item name as written in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value, None if not present/empty/zero")
    unit: str = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元', '万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    variation_explanation: str | None = Field(description="Any explanation for changes in this line item, if stated")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
